WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO interactions (organization_id, lead_id, channel, direction, interaction_type, subject, transcript, occurred_at, metadata)
  SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, 'inbound', $4::text, NULLIF($5::text, ''), $6::text, $7::timestamptz, $8::jsonb
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interactions WHERE organization_id = $1::uuid AND metadata->>'messageKey' = $9::text)
  RETURNING id
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, true AS created FROM ins
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, false FROM interactions WHERE organization_id = $1::uuid AND metadata->>'messageKey' = $9::text
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT id, created,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_outbox WHERE organization_id = $1::uuid AND payload->>'messageKey' = $9::text) AS event_exists
FROM cur;
